hints: Run `npm run dev`, call `curl -i http://localhost:3001/api/categories` and read both sides: the headers of the answer, and the line the server printed. That line is written in `server/src/log.ts`. Everything you need to change starts there.

The middleware runs at the start of every request, before any route. That is the moment to decide the id (the caller's, when it is valid, or a new one), to put it on the answer with `res.setHeader`, and to keep it where the rest of the request can find it, such as `res.locals`.

The log line is written later, in the `finish` handler, which can read the id you decided earlier. For the error line, `handleErrors` in `server/src/app.ts` needs the same id: read it from where the middleware stored it. Check the caller's header with a regular expression before trusting it: it goes into your log.
